title: Separate Compute Root Signature for GPU Bake Passes
description: GPU compute passes (IBL baking, LUT generation) use a separate root signature from the graphics pipeline. This avoids consuming graphics root signature DWORDs and allows compute-specific layouts (root constants + SRV/UAV tables). Per-mip UAV descriptors use a bump allocator at heap offset 4096+ to avoid polluting the main descriptor heap region.
whenToUse: When adding new compute shaders (SSAO, SSR, bloom, particle sim). When the graphics root signature is full (currently 64/64 DWORDs).
whenNotToUse: For simple fullscreen post-process effects that can use the existing graphics pipeline.
